relation_kinds.translation: proposed translation correspondence; not a certified dictionary sense

editorial_review.scope: All 32 verses reviewed against both texts, including every age, total lifespan, repeated genealogy formula and reordered French numeral.
notes: Gen 5:2: the object suffix of created is absorbed by the explicitly named male and female pair.
Gen 5:3–31: age and total-life formulae retain each original numeral and year occurrence even where French has a single word or omits a repeated year.
Gen 5:22–24: Enoch's walking-with-God formula and absence/death contrast retain their distinct original verbs.
Gen 5:29: the name Noah is not conflated with the separate verb for comfort; the demonstrative in the French rendering of the definite article is contextual.
Gen 5:32: the idiom 'son of five hundred years' is linked collectively to the French age construction; the repeated original subject is contextual.
editorial_review.limitations: Same editor performed both passes; no certified dictionary sense; no automated tests. Publication checks remain separate.
